about: Library-index stop-lists (exp095 scale lane, results/stop-effect.json; docs/design/library-index.md section 7). helperPackages and helperPackagePrefixes are dropped from the index at merge time: their code is inlined into everything and names no library. lookupFilePatterns are applied by the LOOKUP, not the build.

stainless.when: the package's source carries X-Stainless-Lang (a Stainless-generated SDK)

shim.when: the package ships both polyfill.js and shim.js (the es-shims template)
